description: How to use the Slovak methodological guidance corpus (PDF documents of Financna sprava SR, MF SR Financny spravodajca, NBS and, when enabled, UVO): what it holds, which Tool to call for what, how to read the results and the honest limits (guidance is not a source of law, the binding text is the PDF at source_url, no stemming, OCR of scans, licences, UVO collection off by default because of robots.txt). One row with the Slovak text and a short Italian summary. No parameters.
